_comment: Defect declarations for the showcase replay clip (demos/showcase.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations.

overlap.reason: uid 8: Team 1's cavalry squadron (uid 8, 9 ranks, 960 wu deep) now deploys with its front rank on its line and marches toward its ATTACK target (uid 2) for the whole clip without reaching it: state MOVING, engaged false, at every sampled tick through 1300. As the deep column turns onto its bearing its bounding box widens from about 320 wu to about 700 wu and its own files close up mid-turn, the deep-block mid-turn mechanism #1546 tracks. CI website demo-diff on PR #1677 (81718f4e): nnd_min 2.996 wu against the 5.0 wu floor, merge-base 9.615. Self-compression of a turning block, not interpenetration with another unit. uid 7: after the routing uid 2 leaves (gone at tick 1074 at the #1739 head, 1012 on the merge-base) uid 7 ends up pressed against its friendly neighbour uid 8, worst at tick 1098 with uid 7 IDLE and uid 8 6.9 wu away; the router's own bodies come no nearer uid 7 than on the merge-base (1.7 against 2.0 wu). On a 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 942): nnd_min 1.168 wu at the #1739 head against the 2.25 wu floor, merge-base 8.762. uid 7's own behaviour is unchanged; tracked as a block crowding after a full-pace router leaves in #1757.

misslotted.reason: uid 7, the same block as the overlap entry, after the routing uid 2 leaves it. On a 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 942): misslotted fraction 0.478 at the #1739 head against 0.25, merge-base 0.130. uid 7 never routs, so nothing in #1739 runs for it; tracked with its overlap in #1757.
